headline: Netflix’s coziest show has made a very quiet return
summary: Netflix's growing library makes it easy to miss hidden gems. A beloved, cozy show has quietly launched a new season. "Midnight Diner" is back for its third season.

headline: Garmin Forerunner 265S hits best price of the year at $300
summary: The Garmin Forerunner 265S is now on sale for $300. This is the lowest price seen for the fitness tracker this year. Ideal for runners with smaller wrists, praised for its fit and OLED screen.

headline: MacBook Neo gets rare $100 Black Friday discount
summary: The MacBook Neo is currently $100 off for Black Friday. Get the 256GB model for $599.99 or the 512GB model for a similar discount. Available at Amazon, Costco, and other retailers.

headline: Android app developers must soon publicly share their address
summary: Google will require Android app developers to publicly share their contact details. This policy change is due to EU Digital Services Act regulations. Developers worldwide will be affected, raising privacy concerns.

headline: GTA 6's Lucia actress, Manni L. Perez, speaks out post-launch
summary: Manni L. Perez, the voice of Lucia in GTA 6, has made her first statement. This marks her initial public comment since the game's release. Fans are eager for her insights on the highly anticipated title.

headline: GTA 6 Fashion: Community Trends
summary: The IGN community is discussing fashion trends within GTA 6. Players are sharing their in-game style preferences and creations. Explore the unique apparel and customization options the game offers.

headline: Eureka Ergonomic offers Black Friday deals for workspace upgrades
summary: Eureka Ergonomic is running Black Friday deals on office and gaming furniture. Upgrade your setup with professional or gamer-themed equipment. Find discounts on desks, chairs, and accessories.

headline: Beats Studio Pro noise-canceling headphones drop below $100 for Black Friday
summary: Beats Studio Pro headphones are under $100 for the first time ever. This Black Friday deal makes them a top noise-canceling headphone bargain. Experience premium sound and active noise cancellation at an unbeatable price.

headline: Huntingdon train attacker guilty of 14 attempted murders
summary: Anthony Williams, 33, was convicted of 14 counts of attempted murder. The attacks occurred on a train and in Peterborough and London. The verdict brings closure to the victims of the violent spree.

headline: Knifeman warned doctor of failing psychosis drugs before Huntingdon attack
summary: The Huntingdon attacker, Anthony Williams, had a long history of criminality. Days before the LNER train attack, he reported his psychosis medication was ineffective. This revelation emerges after his conviction for attempted murder.

headline: Zelensky questions 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship
summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky expressed doubts about the Trump-Putin relationship. He stated that Russia's Vladimir Putin should not be considered a friend. Zelensky made these remarks in a recent BBC interview.

headline: UK net migration lowest since 1997, asylum claims also down
summary: UK net migration recorded its lowest level since 1997, excluding the pandemic. Figures show 77,000 net migrants in the year to June. Asylum claims have also seen a decrease during this period.
